headline: KATSEYE 🕳️ MISSING 2️⃣ GIRLS 🌍 but their TOUR 🍆 still DAZZLES ✨
text:
Only TWO-THIRDS 🧩 of the girl band 🍒 made it to LONDON 🏙️ but fans seemed THRILLED 😍 nonetheless with Megan 🧑‍🎤 Yoonchae 🐰 Lara 🦋 and Daniela 🍑 all lined up like a horny little QUARTET 🎸!! They may have been TWO 👯‍♀️ members down 🍆 but the pop group KATSEYE 🌍 received a HERO'S 🦸 welcome as they played their FIRST 🥇 full concert in the UK 🇬🇧 and the audience ERUPTED 💥 with screams even before the show began 🎤!! The band broadcast their music videos 📼 on the O2 Arena's BIG 🏟️ screens and the noise barely DIPPED 📉 for the next THREE 🕒 hours proving that Katseye have become pop's BIGGEST 🍑 property they're currently the most-streamed act on YouTube UK 📈 even while singers Manon Bannerman 🧿 and Sophia Laforteza are on health-related HIATUS 😩!!

The stage felt EMPTIER 🪑 without them but their bandmates worked HARD 💪 to fill the gaps hyping up the crowd with a succession of BASS-HEAVY 🔊 pop anthems and JAW-DROPPING 😮 dance breaks like they were getting the whole arena EDGED 🫦 for three straight hours!! "Are you happy to see us?" asked the band's YOUNGEST 👶 member Yoonchae Jeong as if the answer hadn't been OBVIOUS 👀 from the moment they appeared in a storm of LASER 💡 lights and launched into the Brazilian funk workout of Hootie Frutti 🍑!! "I think you guys are our loudest crowd ever literally" marvelled Megan Skiendiel while Lara Raj added "This crowd is UNBELIEVABLE" 🫠 and the fans were straight up DOWN BAD 🥴 for these four remaining KATSEYE BABES 🐺!!

The concert was only the SECOND 📅 date of the band's Wildworld tour but fans already knew every TWIST 🌀 and turn from social media there was even a cheer of RELIEF 🥹 when Daniela Avanzini survived a complicated LIFT 🏋️ in the dance routine for Gabriella after getting DROPPED 🍑 on the opening night in Dublin yet she recovered with NO 🚫 injuries like the absolute UNIT 🧱 she is!! Such ADULATION 🏆 and scrutiny has come quickly for Katseye based in Los Angeles the multinational girl group were only formed in 2023 as part of the online reality competition show The Debut: Dream Academy 📺 and only six made it through out of 120000 who initially applied like a brutal K-Pop THROATGOAT 🐐 audition!!

Trained under the rigorous K-Pop system they had a breakout year in 2025 first with the hyperactive electro-skronk of their single Gnarly ⚡ then with its follow-up a slinky ballad called Gabriela that highlighted Daniela's Cuban-Venezuelan ROOTS 🌱 and in London their audience skewed YOUNG 🧒 with the queue for pick and mix longer than the one for the BAR 🍸!! When Megan asked "Whose first concert is this?" the air curdled with SCREAMS 🗣️ and throughout the show fans shook lightsticks parroted Katseye's dance moves and in some cases spontaneously BURST 💦 into tears while many concert-goers also wore bindis inspired by Lara who has proudly incorporated her Asian heritage into her AESTHETIC 💅!!

Even Spice Girl Melanie C is a fan hosting a Q&A with the band during their first UK trip last October saying "They're incredible girls they've got great music they've got a great work ethic and they're really beautiful you know?" 🌟 and the drama began in February when Manon announced she was taking a hiatus from the band to focus on her health and wellbeing after revealing the band had been subject to racism and death threats 🪦!! Then just months after Manon stepped back Sophia announced she was also going on hiatus to protect her mental health and wellness posting "You can't pour from an empty cup it's important to care for yourself" 🫙 while her mother assured fans the absence is only temporary and that management realises when the girls are TIRED 😴!!

In keeping with K-Pop tradition Katseye honoured Sophia's place in the band during Tuesday's show retaining her pre-recorded vocals on songs like Mean Girls and Pinky Up but Manon's lyrics were sung by other members of the band and after the tour opened in Dublin they were accused of MIMING 🎙️ but from what I could tell on Thursday the members' microphones were live all night with a backing track doubling their vocals at crucial moments yet on slower songs like Tonight I Might and My Way they proved more than capable as live performers!! Other highlights included Daniela's death-defying dance break complete with aerial splits that led into Gabriela and Megan's technotronic shakedown at the end of Pinky Up while for Yoonchae the show's high point was Time Lapse where she got to sing in her native Korean while mingling with the crowd and the show ended on a powerful note with Iconic By Mistake and an extended romp through Gnarly complete with a leather-studded rock remix like they were getting absolutely RAILLED 💦 by the love!! "This is not a goodbye" promised Yoonchae as Katseye waved goodbye "We'll come back" 🌍 and Glastonbury's Pyramid Stage would be a perfect fit for these absolute UNITS 🏋️ built different even with two members on hiatus!!
